title: Build an app with Claude code in 3 steps #claudecode
description: Just install VS Code, get a claude pro subscription, and add the right extension. I made a full video about it on my channel.

top_comments.text: Dont forget to set a limit on claudes usage, and that youre not learning anything.

top_comments.text: Just keep in mind that unless you can read and fix the Claude's output code your app is gonna have a terrible UX.
